profile: P150 (one Blackhole P300 chip as N150 mesh)

code.after: final stage code with the served top_k 32 default (batched prefill with shape-stable groups and slot-row assembly, expert-sorted MoE prefill, M-independent prefill numerics, device sampler ceiling 32); commits in work_log.md

named_limitations: Decode traces are still released and recaptured on execution-width changes, slot remaps, host-mode decode, after a prefill that compiled new programs (first-seen single-row lengths and chunk continuations), and on every sampling-spec key miss (greedy/sampled switches and request-seed changes); the mixed-shape trace reuse check therefore fails and first-seen long chunked prompts pay compile time in TTFT (open item, trace lifetime redesign excluded from this resume). Final server release reasons: slot_remap 116, trace_key_miss 25, prefill_program_cache_growth 23, batch_shape_change 12, host_sampling_prefill 6 (183 captures).
Prefills below 512 rows keep the expert-union MoE path; the sorted path is bit-identical but not faster there.
The expert-sorted MoE prefill synchronizes the host once per layer to read the routing (about 2.6 ms of layout work per layer at 2048 rows).
Greedy decode differs between the batch-1 execution and the 32-slot lane (different DRAM-sharded decode program configs); each width is self-consistent. Pre-existing, not changed here.

The engine admits the first request of a client burst in a prefill step of its own, so a burst of N short prompts forms a batched group of N - 1 rows; the 32x128 burst over the 2048-token prefill budget splits into 16 + 15 (+1) row groups.

The device sampler draws from 32 candidates per user (ttnn.sampling tile width); max_device_top_k is 32. The model's generation_config.json default top_k is 64, so the server is launched with --override-generation-config {"top_k":32} (proposed served default, pending operator acceptance); without it every default-recipe sampled request is host-sampled at 97 ms per token and drags concurrent greedy users to about 98 ms per token (default_recipe_latency_ceiling32_no_override.json). Stochastic requests that name top_k above 32 use the plugin's host sampler.
